description: A Dart class 'TokenStore' that manages storage and retrieval of authentication tokens and session IDs using SharedPreferences in a Flutter app.

classes.name: TokenStore
classes.description: Manages storage of access tokens, refresh tokens, and session IDs using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current access token from shared preferences.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Stores or clears the access token in shared preferences.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current refresh token from shared preferences.

methods.name: setRefreshToken
methods.description: Stores or clears the refresh token in shared preferences.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the stored WebSocket session ID.

methods.name: setSessionId
methods.description: Stores or clears the WebSocket session ID.
